description: This file is a platform-specific shell script used in the openwrt build system, defining functions for checking and upgrading firmware images for the bcm6328 device.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to verify the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the firmware upgrade based on the board name, delegating to specific upgrade functions.
